records.summary: Jews were expelled from Bohemia in 1541.

records.title: Sigismund Augustus issues a 1551 order
records.summary: King Sigismund Augustus issued an order restricting unauthorized inter-district interference and bans.

records.title: Privilege granted to Lviv Jews
records.summary: Sigismund Augustus granted Lviv Jews a special privilege in 1553.

records.title: Birth of Meir of Lublin
records.summary: Meir of Lublin was born in Lublin in 1558.

records.title: Death of Shalom Shakhna
records.summary: Shalom Shakhna died in Lublin in 1559.

records.title: Royal confirmation of Jewish property rights
records.summary: King Sigismund Augustus confirmed Jews' right to buy and sell houses.

records.title: Opening of a printing house in Krakow
records.summary: Isaac son of Aaron opened a new printing house in Krakow in 1569.

records.title: Synagogue rebuilding
records.summary: The old synagogue was rebuilt after the 1571 fire.

records.title: 1571 fire in the Jewish quarter
records.summary: A devastating fire destroyed nearly all houses in Lviv’s Jewish quarter.

records.title: Henryk Valois's reign
records.summary: Henryk Valois reigned during 1573–1574.

records.title: Stephen Báthory elected king of Poland
records.summary: Stephen Báthory was elected king of Poland in 1576.

records.title: Stefan Batory spent winter in Lviv
records.summary: Stefan Batory spent the entire winter of 1578 in Lviv.

records.title: Plot sale to Isaac ben Nahman
records.summary: The city council decided to sell a plot to Isaac ben Nahman on September 24, 1580.

records.title: Founding of the synagogue
records.summary: The synagogue was established in 1582 by Isaac ben Nahman.

records.title: Synagogue construction completed
records.summary: Paulus completed the synagogue building in 1582.

records.title: Gothic synagogue construction
records.summary: A Gothic synagogue building was erected in 1582.

records.title: Construction of synagogue building
records.summary: The synagogue building was established in 1582.

records.title: Printing of Sefer Sam HaHayim
records.summary: Sefer Sam HaHayim was printed in 1590.

records.title: Yeshiva foundation
records.summary: Israel ben Joseph Eidels founded a yeshiva in a purchased house.

records.title: Jesuits arrive in Lviv
records.summary: Three Jesuits were brought to Lviv in a ceremonial procession in 1591.

records.title: Student attacks on Jews
records.summary: Student attacks on Jews occurred in Lviv during 1592, 1613, and 1640–1643.

records.title: Completion of second construction stage
records.summary: Nahman and architect Paulo Romano completed the building's second stage in 1595.

records.title: Nachmanovitz dismissed from office
records.summary: Nachmanovitz was accused of extorting money and dismissed in 1595.

records.title: Meir ben Gedaliah serves as head of Lviv’s rabbinical court
records.summary: Meir ben Gedaliah served as head of the rabbinical court in Lviv in 1599.

records.title: Killing of Aharon Kamkhan
records.summary: Officer Albert Usytsky killed Aharon Kamkhan during a soldier-related attack in 1600.

records.title: Royal commission reviewed the synagogue land dispute
records.summary: A new royal commission was established in 1603 to examine the Lviv land dispute.

records.title: Synagogue used as court
records.summary: From 1604, the synagogue also served as a seat of the rabbinical court and as a genizah for community registers.

records.title: Construction of a new community house
records.summary: Mordecai ben Isaac built a new house and founded Hekdesh in 1604.

records.title: Commission inspection in Lviv
records.summary: A royal commission inspected plots and houses in Lviv during a property dispute.

records.title: Jewish delegation traveled to Warsaw
records.summary: Three Jewish representatives traveled to Warsaw in February 1606.

records.title: Nachmanovitz and Abraham killed
records.summary: Nachmanovitz and his servant Abraham were attacked, killed, and robbed in 1607.

records.title: Commission assessment of buildings
records.summary: A commission assessed the buildings in Bova in mid-January 1607.

records.title: Opening of the new synagogue
records.summary: The new synagogue was ceremonially opened in spring 1609.

records.title: Yitzhak wrote Shir HaGeulah
records.summary: Yitzhak wrote Shir HaGeulah with commentary in 1609.

records.title: Rabbi Moshe son of Yosef heads a yeshiva
records.summary: Rabbi Moshe son of Yosef headed a yeshiva in the great community.

records.title: Rabbi Yehuda Leib heads a yeshiva in Lviv
records.summary: Rabbi Yehuda Leib became head of a yeshiva in Lviv.

records.title: Pultovich leaves the Jewish quarter
records.summary: In 1613, Ian Baptist Pultovich was forced to sell his house and leave the Jewish quarter.

records.title: Death of Nachman
records.summary: Nachman died in 1616; Roiza then managed and expanded the family’s businesses.

records.title: Meir ben Gedaliah dies in Lublin
records.summary: Meir ben Gedaliah served in Lublin until his death in 1616.

records.title: Death of Rabbi Israel Eidelis
records.summary: Rabbi Israel died in 1616.

records.title: Fire in the Jewish street
records.summary: A major fire lasted two days and destroyed all houses in the Jewish street.

records.title: Levko purchased a house
records.summary: Levko purchased a house from Jan Baptist Poltovitz in 1618.

records.title: Jacob Gombricht served as community treasurer
records.summary: Jacob Gombricht served as community treasurer from 1620 to 1634.

records.title: Samuel Tshalbisha trades in Lviv
records.summary: Samuel traded in eastern goods while residing in Lviv from 1621 to 1635.

records.title: Death of Abraham son of David
records.summary: Abraham son of David died in Av 1622.

records.title: Death of Nathan son of Eliezer
records.summary: Nathan son of Eliezer died during Hanukkah in 1622.

records.title: Fire near the synagogue
records.summary: A massive fire near the synagogue spread through the quarter and destroyed about 1,200 houses.

records.title: Great fire of 1623
records.summary: A fire destroyed 1,200 houses, including all Jewish homes.

records.title: Jacob Gombricht's first public appearance
records.summary: Jacob Gombricht first appeared on the public stage in 1624.

records.title: Zolkiew community selected its own rabbi
records.summary: In 1626, Zolkiew selected its own rabbi, beginning its process of independence.

records.title: Yitzhak headed a yeshiva in Poznań
records.summary: Yitzhak served as head of a yeshiva in Poznań in 1627.

records.title: Tailors' Guild established
records.summary: A tailors' guild existed by 1627.

records.title: Jewish tailors’ association documented
records.summary: A Jewish tailors’ association existed in 1627.

records.title: Royal recommendation for compromise with Lviv Jews
records.summary: Sigismund III recommended that Lviv authorities compromise with the Jews.

records.title: Death of Joseph son of Jechiel
records.summary: Joseph son of Jechiel died on 1 Av 1629.

records.title: Death of Meir son of Naphtali Hirz
records.summary: Meir son of Naphtali Hirz died in Tevet 1629.

records.title: Mordecai Ashkenazi served as rabbi
records.summary: Mordecai Ashkenazi served as rabbi of the out-of-city congregation from 1630 to 1636.

records.title: Death of Mordecai ben Zvi Ashkenazi
records.summary: The preceding rabbinic figure, apparently Abraham Rappaport, died in 1630; Mordecai ben Zvi Ashkenazi succeeded him.

records.title: Death of Jacob-Kapel son of Asher
records.summary: Jacob-Kapel son of Asher died on 28 Tishrei 1630.

records.title: Death of Mordecai son of David Katz
records.summary: Mordecai son of David Katz died on 1 Nisan 1631.

records.title: Death of Jekuthiel Zalman son of Hanokh
records.summary: Jekuthiel Zalman son of Hanokh died on 3 Tammuz 1631.

records.title: Death of Judah Liva son of Jacob
records.summary: Judah Liva son of Jacob died on 1 Elul 1631.

records.title: Death of Mordecai son of Nathan Neta
records.summary: Mordecai son of Nathan Neta died on 21 Tishrei 1631.

records.title: Death of Jacob son of Eliezer Kiknish
records.summary: Jacob son of Eliezer Kiknish died during the Great Hoshana in 1631.

records.title: Great Synagogue rebuilt
records.summary: The Great Synagogue was rebuilt in 1632.

records.title: Royal legal extension granted to Jacob Gombricht
records.summary: King Wladyslaw granted Jacob Gombricht a one-year creditor payment extension.

records.title: Royal privilege granted to Yitzhak and Abramovich
records.summary: The king granted them court-servant status and commercial privileges in 1634.

records.title: Death of Roza
records.summary: Roza died naturally in 1635.

records.title: Death of Mordecai Ashkenazi
records.summary: Mordecai Ashkenazi died on the first day of Passover in 1636.

records.title: Death of Rabbi Eliyahu ben Abraham Kalman Kos
records.summary: Rabbi Eliyahu ben Abraham Kalman Kos died on 8 Nisan 5396 (1636).

records.title: Clash at a Jewish funeral procession
records.summary: A Christian procession encountered a Jewish funeral, leading to violence and injuries in 1636.

records.title: Death of Judah ben Shemaiah
records.summary: Judah ben Shemaiah died on 7 Nisan 1637.

records.title: Public auction of Jewish goods
records.summary: Jewish goods were sold at public auction before the king’s order of 13 February 1637; the auction date is not stated.

records.title: Meir’s rabbinical service in the city
records.summary: Meir served as rabbi and head of the rabbinical court from 1638 to 1654.

records.title: Fire of 1640
records.summary: A fire destroyed nearly the entire suburb; the synagogue and houses were rebuilt.

records.title: Attack and robbery of Jewish homes
records.summary: Monks and students attacked Jewish homes during Elijah's wedding on 24 July 1640.

records.title: Summons before the voivode’s court
records.summary: The voivode summoned both sides to appear before his court on 8 August 1640.

records.title: Community fire of 1645
records.summary: The community suffered another major fire in 1645.

records.title: Death of Meshulam Zalczburg
records.summary: Meshulam Zalczburg died in 1645.

records.title: Fires in the Jewish community
records.summary: Nearly all houses burned in fires during 1648 and 1655.

records.title: Khmelnytsky advances west
records.summary: In April 1648, Khmelnytsky led a Zaporozhian force westward.

records.title: Khmelnytsky defeats Polish forces
records.summary: From May 6 to 15, 1648, Khmelnytsky defeated Polish armies.

records.title: Lviv defense preparations
records.summary: Residents organized defenses and Jewish guards protected sections adjoining the Jewish quarter.
